text:
Elena (partnerships): FYI — scheduling a vendor coordination call TOMORROW 10:00am PT to align on H200/MI300/B200 marketplace rollouts + SI integration timelines. Agenda: per-vendor availability windows, marketplace checklist, SI owners, embargo/announce cadence, and fallback model variants. Ping if that time conflicts.

Raj (cloud): I can make 10:00. Quick Q — AMD still marking MI300 GA as tentative for some regions; we should ask vendors for per-region availability and capacity caps.

Jules (product): Product request: we need perf profiles (latency/throughput) for 4-bit quantized and fp16 variants on each SKU to populate marketplace SKU pages. Can eng produce those by next week?

Marta (eng-runtime): We'll run perf passes for H100/H200/MI300 this week. Need a sample model and a 512-token realistic trace. Also kernel/toolkit matrix matters (CUDA 12.5 vs 13.x, ROCm x.y). @Elena please add kernel/version matrix to the agenda.

Elena (partnerships): Added. Also let's lock SI integration owners per vendor — who will own HW soak tests vs adapter work for PartnerX/PartnerY?

Ken (marketing): Marketing preference: one coordinated announcement per vendor family. We need embargo lead times — marketplace approval often takes 3 business days for container verification; press teams usually want 72h lead. Anyone got confirmation? :thinking_face:

release-bot: Reminder — vendor NDAs may restrict sharing hard launch dates until legal signs off. Please upload proposed announcement drafts to /shared/partnerships/drafts and tag @legal.

Raj (cloud): On the marketplace checklist: verified container + AMI, billing meter tags, region enablement, and documented runbook for autoscaler/node labels. Can eng deliver a verified container by end of next week for H200? Example tag: `redwood/inference:release-h200-2026-03-01`.

Marta (eng-runtime): For H200 & B200 likely yes. MI300 depends on driver stability with our quant kernels — might slip a few days. We'll call out blockers in the meeting. Example verification command we run: `docker run --rm -e REDWOOD_MODELS=llama-13b redwood/inference:release-h200-2026-03-01 ./verify.sh`.

Jules (product): Can we create a canonical checklist in the meeting notes: [model perf profile, verified container, perf report, TCO guidance & token pricing suggestions, SI playbook/runbook, legal signoff, marketplace metadata]?

Elena (partnerships): Yes — I'll own the checklist doc and post it to the shared folder. Also inviting SI leads: @Nisha for PartnerX, plus PartnerY contact.

Nisha (solutions): I can join the call. PartnerX will need a runbook for node labels, autoscaler settings, and a sample helm/manifest. We have a draft runbook I can share.

Ken (marketing): For cadence: propose internal soft-launch 7 days, public launch 14 days after signoff (subject to vendor embargo). If vendor insists on coordinated press, we'll tighten windows.

Elena (partnerships): Final item — fallback model plan if capacity is constrained: propose 7B and 3B quantized variants, plus a default small fp16. We'll include these as optional marketplace SKUs. Meeting invite sent (calendar event + Zoom). Agenda link + pre-reads in the doc.

Marta (eng-runtime): One more: please include a compatibility matrix row for kernel/blas/quant libs (e.g., cuBLAS vX, triton commit hash) — small differences affect latency.

Raj (cloud): Noted. I'll prep region-capacity map and billing tag template before the call.

Elena (partnerships): Great — thanks team. See you tomorrow 10:00am PT. :calendar:
